name: Pilisjászfalu (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pilisjászfalu: a white and red shield with a green mound, a patriarchal cross and a hunting horn, within a green wreath, below a yellow scroll inscribed PILISJÁSZFALU.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pilisjászfalu arms with wreath and scroll
